response.sql: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), avg_cnt AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_c FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.cnt - a.avg_c) AS avg_excess FROM side_counts s CROSS JOIN avg_cnt a WHERE s.cnt > a.avg_c

assumptions.assumption: The average count across sides is taken over sides that appear after the inner join (sides with at least one matched risk/margin record); sides with zero matches are not included. A NULL dealedge, if present, would form its own group and count as a side.
If no side exceeds the average (e.g., all counts equal), the query returns one row with NULL values rather than zeros.
